title: ✉️ Task 1.1 — Do'stona xat (Informal Letter)
lesson:
✉️ *Task 1.1 — Do'stona (Informal) xat*

📏 *Hajmi: 50 so'z atrofida (40-60 so'z oralig'ida)*

1️⃣ *Salomlashish:* Dear [Ism],
2️⃣ *Kirish:* Qisqa hol-ahvol so'rash yoki xat sababini aytish
3️⃣ *Asosiy qism:* 1-2 gapda asosiy xabar — do'stona, erkin uslubda, qisqartmalar (I'm, it's) ishlatiladi
4️⃣ *Yakunlash:* Qisqa yakuniy gap
5️⃣ *Imzo:* Best wishes, / Love, — so'ng ismingiz

⚠️ *Muhim:* Task 1.1 juda qisqa — faqat asosiy fikrni yeting, ortiqcha tafsilotga o'tmang. So'z sonidan oshib ketish ball kamaytiradi.

🗣 *Foydali iboralar:*
— It was great to hear from you!
— Just a quick note to say...
— Anyway, I'd better go now.
— Write back soon!

title: 📄 Task 1.2 — Rasmiy/Yarim-rasmiy xat
lesson:
📄 *Task 1.2 — Rasmiy/Yarim-rasmiy xat (Formal/Semi-formal Letter)*

📏 *Hajmi: 120-150 so'z*

1️⃣ *Salomlashish:* Dear Mr./Ms. [Familiya], yoki Dear Sir/Madam,
2️⃣ *Kirish:* Xat maqsadini aniq bildiring — "I am writing to inform/request/complain..."
3️⃣ *Asosiy qism (2-3 paragraf):* Har bir paragraf — bitta fikr, dalil bilan. Rasmiy uslub: qisqartmalar ishlatilmaydi.
4️⃣ *Yakunlash:* "I look forward to your response." / "Please do not hesitate to contact me."
5️⃣ *Imzo:* Yours faithfully, (ism noma'lum) / Yours sincerely, (ism ma'lum) — to'liq ism

⚠️ *Muhim:* 120 so'zdan kam yozsangiz — fikringiz yetarli rivojlantirilmagan hisoblanadi; 150 so'zdan oshsangiz — vaqtni noto'g'ri taqsimlagan bo'lasiz.

🗣 *Foydali iboralar:*
— I am writing to inform you that...
— I would be grateful if you could...
— Please find attached...
— Should you require further information, please contact me.

title: 🔄 Task 2 — Paraphrasing (Essay ichida)
lesson:
🔄 *Paraphrasing — fikrni boshqa so'zlar bilan ifodalash*

📏 *Task 2 insholari uchun hajm: 180-200 so'z*

Insho savolini so'zma-so'z takrorlamaslik kerak — buning o'rniga uni **o'z so'zlaringiz bilan** qayta ifodalaysiz (odatda kirish qismida ishlatiladi).

*Usullar:*
1️⃣ *Sinonim ishlatish:* important → crucial/essential
2️⃣ *So'z turkumini o'zgartirish:* to decide (fe'l) → decision (ot)
3️⃣ *Gap tuzilishini o'zgartirish:* Active → Passive

*Namuna:*
Original: "Many people think that social media has a negative effect on teenagers."
Paraphrase: "It is widely believed that social networking platforms negatively influence young people."

title: 🔗 Task 2 — Bog'lovchilar (Linking Words)
lesson:
🔗 *Insholarda bog'lovchilar (Linking Words)*

📏 *Hajm: 180-200 so'z*

Fikrlarni bir-biriga bog'lash uchun ishlatiladi — matningizni mantiqiy va oqimli qiladi.

*Qo'shimcha fikr:* Furthermore, Moreover, In addition, Also
*Qarama-qarshilik:* However, On the other hand, Nevertheless, Although
*Sabab-natija:* Therefore, As a result, Consequently, Due to
*Misol keltirish:* For example, For instance, Such as
*Xulosa:* In conclusion, To sum up, Overall

*Namuna:*
"Remote work offers flexibility. **However**, it can also lead to isolation. **Therefore**, companies should organize regular team meetings."

title: 📊 Grafik/Diagrammani tasvirlash (Line/Bar Chart)
lesson:
📊 *Academic Task 1 — Grafik/Diagrammani tasvirlash*

📏 *Hajm: kamida 150 so'z*

Bu yerda insho yozilmaydi — sizga chizma (line/bar chart, jadval) beriladi, va siz undagi **ma'lumotlarni tasvirlaysiz** (o'z fikringizni bildirmaysiz).

1️⃣ *Kirish (Introduction):* Chizma sarlavhasini o'z so'zlaringiz bilan qayta ifodalang (paraphrase) — nusxa ko'chirmang.
2️⃣ *Umumiy tavsif (Overview):* 2 ta ENG MUHIM tendensiyani (eng yuqori, eng past, umumiy o'zgarish yo'nalishi) qisqa yozing — bu qism juda muhim, ko'pincha talabalar buni unutadi.
3️⃣ *Tafsilotlar (Body 1-2):* Aniq raqamlar bilan taqqoslang, guruhlab tasvirlang (masalan, o'sayotgan ko'rsatkichlar / kamayayotganlar).

🗣 *Tendensiya ifodalari:*
— increased/rose/grew steadily/sharply/gradually
— decreased/fell/declined slightly/dramatically
— remained stable/constant
— fluctuated
— reached a peak of..., hit its lowest point at...

⚠️ *Muhim qoidalar:*
— Shaxsiy fikr bildirmang ("I think..." ishlatilmaydi)
— Har bir raqamni tasvirlash shart emas — asosiy tendensiyalarni tanlab yozing
— Kelajak haqida taxmin qilmang, faqat berilgan ma'lumotni tasvirlang

title: ⚙️ Jarayonni tasvirlash (Process Diagram)
lesson:
⚙️ *Academic Task 1 — Jarayon diagrammasini tasvirlash*

📏 *Hajm: kamida 150 so'z*

Sizga bosqichma-bosqich jarayon (masalan, ishlab chiqarish jarayoni) beriladi, uni tartib bilan tasvirlaysiz.

1️⃣ *Kirish:* Jarayon nima haqida ekanini umumiy aytib o'ting.
2️⃣ *Umumiy tavsif:* Jarayon nechta asosiy bosqichdan iboratligini va qayerdan boshlanib, qayerda tugashini ayting.
3️⃣ *Bosqichlar:* Har bir bosqichni **Passive Voice** va ketma-ketlik so'zlari bilan tasvirlang.

🗣 *Ketma-ketlik so'zlari:*
— First/Initially, ... Then/Next/After that, ... Following this, ... Finally/Lastly, ...

🗣 *Passive Voice namunasi:*
— The raw material is collected.
— It is then transported to the factory.
— Once processed, it is packaged for distribution.

⚠️ *Muhim:* Jarayon tasvirida deyarli har doim **Passive Voice** ishlatiladi (chunki kim bajarayotgani emas, nima sodir bo'layotgani muhim).
